name: gke-statefulset-without-probes
description: Audits, detects, and proposes fixes for GKE StatefulSets that are protected by a PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) but lack container readiness probes (GKE insight subtype PDB_STATEFULSET_WITHOUT_PROBES), causing replacement Pods to be counted as healthy before they are ready during voluntary disruptions. Use when asked to check, audit, or propose fixes for the PDB_STATEFULSET_WITHOUT_PROBES condition, missing readinessProbe configurations on PDB-protected GKE StatefulSets, or premature eviction of StatefulSet replicas during node pool upgrades or drains despite having a PDB. Don't use for StatefulSets missing a PDB (PDB_UNPROTECTED_STATEFULSET), PDBs that allow zero disruptions (PDB_UNPERMISSIVE), general probe and PDB setup unrelated to this condition (use gke-reliability), Pods stuck in Pending (use gke-workload-troubleshooting), ComputeClass configuration (use gke-compute-classes), manifest generation (use gke-manifest-generation), or cluster upgrade planning (use gke-upgrades).
